lifecycle.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this automation? This action cannot be undone. Discovered jobs will remain but lose their automation reference.

list.emptyBody: Create your first automation to start discovering jobs automatically.
list.retiredWarning: This job board was removed and no longer runs. Delete this automation.
list.resumeMissing: Resume missing - select a new one

wizard.created: Your automation has been created and will run at the scheduled time.
wizard.updated: Your automation has been updated successfully.

basics.nameHint: A descriptive name to identify this automation

resume.label: Resume for Matching
resume.hint: Jobs will be matched against this resume
resume.noResumes: No resumes found. Please create a resume with enough content in your profile first.
resume.noneUsable: None of your resumes can be used yet.
resume.someUnusable: {count} of your resumes can't be selected.
resume.needsSections: A resume needs at least {min} sections — an attached file does not count. Fill it in under <profile>Profile</profile>.

matching.label: Match Threshold: {value}%
matching.hint: Only save listings whose AI match score reaches this threshold. Analyzed listings that score below it are discarded — set it lower to keep more.

schedule.label: Daily Run Time
schedule.hint: The automation will run daily at this time (server timezone)

companies.label: {provider} Companies
companies.noMatches: No matches. Try "Add by URL" below.
companies.hint: Select {provider} companies to monitor their job boards for new openings.
companies.skipped: Added what fits — {skipped} skipped at the {max}-company limit.

urlHint.lever: Or paste a jobs.lever.co link or token
urlHint.ashby: Or paste a jobs.ashbyhq.com link or token

titles.label: Target job titles
titles.hint: Optional. Listings whose title matches rank higher.
titles.empty: No job titles found. Type to create one.

keywords.label: Keywords / skills
keywords.hint: Optional. Matched against title and description.
keywords.empty: No keywords found. Type to create one.

locations.hint: Optional. Used only to filter results when the toggle below is on (not part of ranking).
locations.empty: No locations found. Type to create one.

targeting.noSignal: Add at least one target title or keyword. Without them there is nothing to rank jobs against, so this automation will save no listings.
targeting.strictLabel: Only show jobs in these locations
targeting.strictHint: When on, jobs matching none of your locations are dropped before ranking. Remote roles always pass.

runOptions.topKHint: The number of listings that get full AI match analysis each run. Higher means more coverage but slower, costlier runs.
runOptions.saveHint: When on, listings that are relevant but didn't make the top-K are also saved, lexically-ranked but not yet AI-scored. They can be analyzed on-demand later from the discovered jobs list.

header.retired: The {board} job board was removed and no longer runs. Delete this automation.
header.waitAnalysis: Wait for the in-progress job analysis to finish

abort.title: Abort this run?
abort.description: The run will stop after the current step. Jobs already discovered are kept; remaining jobs won't be processed.

logs.title: Automation Logs
logs.empty: No logs yet. Run the automation to see logs.
logs.noMatch: No logs match the selected filter.
logs.clearDescription: This will permanently remove all current logs. This action cannot be undone.

runHistory.emptyBody: Run history will appear here once the automation runs.
runHistory.title: Run History

discovered.emptyBody: Jobs discovered by automations will appear here.
discovered.noMatchBody: Try selecting a different status above.

row.prerankTitle: Internal lexical relevance score (not an AI match)
row.runInProgress: A run is in progress. Wait until it completes.

toasts.accepted: The job has been added to your tracked jobs.

clear.title: Clear discovered jobs?
clear.description: Accepted jobs are always kept. This permanently deletes all dismissed jobs. This action cannot be undone.
clear.descriptionWithNew: Accepted jobs are always kept. This permanently deletes all dismissed jobs and all unreviewed new jobs. This action cannot be undone.

match.provisionalTitle: Scored from an incomplete job description — re-run the match after adding the full posting.
match.legacy: This match was saved before the latest update. Re-run the match for the full breakdown.

prerank.title: Lexical pre-rank
prerank.description: Internal relevance score used to pick which jobs get AI-analyzed. Each hit is weighted by how rare the term is across the board. Not an AI match — compare it against the % above to gauge pre-rank accuracy.

errors.maxAutomations: Maximum of {max} automations allowed per user
errors.hourTaken: Another automation already runs at {hour}:00. Please choose a different time.
errors.resumeNotFound: Resume not found or doesn't belong to you
errors.boardRemoved: The {board} job board has been removed. This automation can only be deleted.
errors.runInProgress: A run is in progress for this automation. Please wait until it completes before analyzing jobs.
errors.noScore: AI did not return a match score
